qualify.action: Qualify the actual permitted effects, preserving any missing approval.
exit: Record current authority or the exact decision still pending.

apply.action: Perform only currently approved work; preserve unknown or blocked effects.
exit: Record the actual outcome and preserve any gated branch before moving.

research.action: Within allowed access, analyze capacity/growth and prepare options, projections and a framework.
exit: The decision packet contains context, evidence, options, ramifications and requested scope.

other.source_ref: Another authorized avenue in the same assignment
other.action: Advance another accepted work package while retaining the deferred branch.
exit: Record useful progress or that all remaining permitted work is genuinely gated.

reconcile.action: Reconcile every active/deferred obligation and the canonical source gate.
exit: All required work is accepted or explicitly transferred to a named tracked objective.
